questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
A hydrocarbon A CnH2n-4 on ozonolysis gives
CH32CHCH2CHO,OHCCH2CH2CHO  and  CH3COCH3 .
The value of n is
questions.solution:
Based on the formula of hydrocarbon CnH2n-4 the degree of unsaturation is 3. So, there is two case:

(I) 3 double bonds

(II) 1 double bond and 1 triple bond

Second case can be easily rejected because products of ozonolysis are aldehyde or ketone rather than carboxylic acid.

So the alkene would be:

(CH3)2CHCH2CH=CHCH2CH2CH=CHCH2CH2CH=CCH32

Which on ozonolysis will give products as:

CH32CHCH2CH=CHCH2CH2CH=CHCH2CH2CH=CCH32

→Ozonolysis (CH3)2CHCH2CHO+2OHCCH2CH2CHO+CH3COCH3

The formula of alkene is C16H28

So the value of ‘x’ is 16.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Consider the following substances

1. CH3C≡CCH3

2. CH3CH2C≡CH

3. CH3CH=CHCH3

4. CH3CH2CH=CH2

Which of the following reagent can be used to distinguish the compound (2) from the rest of the compounds?
options: Ammonical  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  or ammoniacal cuprous chloride
questions.solution:
Compound (2) has acidic hydrogen (acetylinic hydrogen), which can be replaced.

CH3-CH2-C≡CH+AgNH32+OH-→CH3-CH2C≡CAgWhite ppt+H2O+2NH3

CH3CH2C≡CH+CuNH32+OH-→CH3CH2C≡CCuRed ppt.+H2O+2NH3

Compounds 1, 3 and 4 have no acidic hydrogen. Therefore, they do not react with reagent option D.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Calculate the octane number of gasoline fuel, which contains <math> <mrow>  <mtext>25%</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>n-heptane</mtext></mrow></math> and <math><mn>75</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> is <math> <mrow>  <mtext>iso-octane</mtext></mrow></math>.
questions.solution:
Octane number is defined as the percentage by volume of iso-octane present in the mixture of iso-octan⁡e and n-heptan⁡e which has the same antiknocking properties as the fuel under examination.

Given fuel (25% n-heptane +75% iso-octane) Hence, octane number = 75 (because iso octane is 75%)

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
In the Kjeldahl's method for estimation of nitrogen present in a soil sample, ammonia evolved from 0.75 g of sample neutralized 10 mL of 1M H2SO4. The percentage of nitrogen in the soil is
[Report your answer upto two decimal places]
questions.solution:
In 0.75 g of sample the percentage of nitrogen can be find out as follows
N%=14×N×VWO.C.×100
Here N×V of H2SO4=n×M×V
=2×1×10×10-3=20×10-3
% Nitrogen =14×20×10-30.75×100=37.33%
